name: window-grid-kde
description: A KDE Plasma window activity and virtual desktop grid utility.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n HELPER,APP,KWIN "npm run watch:helper" "npm run dev:app" "npm run watch:kwin"
scripts.dev:app: bash -c 'until qdbus6 2>/dev/null | grep -q com.anthony.WindowGridKDE; do sleep 0.3; done && npm run deploy:kwin' && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-vite dev
scripts.deploy:kwin: mkdir -p ~/.local/share/kwin/scripts/testinglink/contents/code && cp scripts/window-grid-kde-kwin-script.js ~/.local/share/kwin/scripts/testinglink/contents/code/main.js && echo 'Deploying KWin script...' && qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /Scripting org.kde.kwin.Scripting.unloadScript testinglink; qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /Scripting org.kde.kwin.Scripting.loadScript "$HOME/.local/share/kwin/scripts/testinglink/contents/code/main.js" testinglink; qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /Scripting org.kde.kwin.Scripting.start && echo 'Done.'
